hook: Your local tree might have been to the Moon.
title: Trees grown from seeds that orbited the Moon
description:
Apollo 14 carried tree seeds around the Moon in 1971. After they returned, the seeds were planted on Earth and the trees became known as Moon trees. Some still stand today.

#Shorts #Apollo14 #Space
comment_prompt: Would you plant a Moon tree? Yes or no
